name: demo-video
description: Turn your app or UI into a ~50s feature film — record your real running app (or an HTML mockup, a terminal, or a Remotion scene), narrated with AI voiceover (free Edge TTS by default; optional paid ElevenLabs), synced karaoke captions, a music bed (free by default; optional paid ElevenLabs Music), and your brand's palette/fonts/end-cards. One brand.yaml drives it.
